bind_address.description: IP address or hostname to bind the WebSocket proxy to. Use '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces.

bind_port.description: Port number to listen for incoming WebSocket connections.

target_host.description: Backend host to which WebSocket traffic will be proxied (single-target mode).

target_port.description: Backend port (e.g., VNC, RDP, SSH) to proxy to (single-target mode).

ssl_target.description: Enable WSS (secure WebSocket) by presenting TLS to clients. Requires ssl_cert and ssl_key.

ssl_cert.description: Path to SSL/TLS certificate file (PEM format). Required if ssl_target=true.

ssl_key.description: Path to SSL/TLS private key file (PEM format). Required if ssl_target=true.

ssl_ca.description: Path to CA bundle (PEM format) for mutual TLS client authentication (optional).

log_level.description: Logging verbosity: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, or CRITICAL.

log_file.description: Path to log file. If empty, logs to stdout (stderr in some builds).

idle_timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity before closing idle WebSocket or backend connections.

tcp_keepalive.description: Enable TCP keepalive probes to backend connections to detect dead peers.

allowed_origins.description: List of allowed HTTP origins for CORS. If empty, all origins are permitted (not recommended for production).

routes.description: List of path-based routing rules. Use when proxying multiple backends on different paths (e.g., /vnc1→localhost:5900, /vnc2→localhost:5901).

path.description: URL path (e.g., '/vnc' or '/proxy/5901'). Must start with '/' and be unique.

daemonize.description: Run websockify as a background daemon process (requires root for binding low ports).

pidfile.description: File path to write the daemon process PID (used only if daemonize=true).

user.description: System user to drop privileges to after startup (requires root initially).

group.description: System group to drop privileges to after startup (requires root initially).

compression.description: Enable permessage-deflate compression for WebSocket messages (may reduce CPU if bandwidth-limited).

ws_path.description: URL path prefix for the WebSocket endpoint (e.g., '/ws' or '/proxy').
